request.question: Select the single best primary handler for this request.

options.description: git_client: Handles local Git configuration, credentials cache, and command behavior.
identity_login: Handles inability to authenticate to the corporate identity provider.
repository_admin: Handles branch protection, hooks, repository settings, and archival.
source_access: Handles repository visibility, team membership, Git host authorization, and transfer-related permissions.
vpn_network: Handles tunnel establishment, routes, DNS, and reachability to internal networks.
